title: Trust Yakaiswa kuRwizi
intro: Mweya wakatarisana nemutemo usingagoneki, uko hupenyu hwemwana achangoberekwa hwakanga hwakarembera. Achitungamirirwa nekufemerwa naMwari, murairo wakaoma wakateererwa, uye chakavanzika chinokosha chakaiswa pamvura, asi chakadzorerwa nenzira isingatarisirwi.
clues: Ndaigara pasi pemumvuri wemudzvinyiriri airayira kuurayiwa kwevana vacheche.
Kufemerwa naMwari kwakauya kwandiri, kundiraira kuti ndiite chiito chekupererwa uye chinobaya mwoyo.
Ndakaisa mwana wangu mubhokisi ndokumuisa parwizi rwaiyerera.
Mwoyo wangu wakava usina chinhu, uye ndakapotsa ndaburitsa chakavanzika, asi Allah akasimbisa kutsunga kwangu.
Ndakatuma mumwe munhu kuti atevere rwendo rwemwana achidzika nerwizi sezvo mvura yaitakura bhokisi.
Mwana uyu akawanikwa nemhuri yemudzvinyiriri, uye pakupedzisira, ndakabatanazve nemwana wangu ndikava muchengeti wevana.

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
